findings.title: Test statistics leak into augmentation search
findings.quote:
for aug in candidates:
    val_acc = evaluate(model, test_loader, aug)
    scores[aug] = val_acc
best_aug = max(candidates, key=lambda aug: scores[aug])
return best_aug
findings.claim: Test accuracy is used to choose the augmentation.
findings.concern: The reported test accuracy is optimistic.
findings.resolution: Use a validation split for augmentation selection.

verification.note: The JSON records the same selection loop.

findings.title: No seed control for the reported variance
findings.claim: The seed is set once at the start of training.

findings.title: Seeding is inconsistent across runs
findings.claim: The seed is reset after the main training call.
findings.concern: This makes repeated runs look more stable than they are.
